card.name: Digits inside multi-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (or decimal point) in the middle of a number, where more digits follow. Most often the first or second digit of a two- or three-digit figure, such as a percentage, patient count or dose.

modes.label: Digit in a percentage or count
modes.description: A digit that begins or continues a patient count, percentage or fraction in trial results.
modes.example: patients were predominantly African American (N=34, 6<<8>>%), had less than a high school education

modes.label: Digit in a calculation or table value
modes.description: A digit inside a computed dose or a decimal value in a table.
modes.example: Replacement Iron = 500 x 0.20 = <<1>>00 mg INFeD dose volume
